# Governance

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Recorded decisions to review, gaps by site and the audit trail for this session.

## What is on the screen

1. What to review. Recorded decisions waiting for review, such as overrides and refusals, for this session.
2. Waiting for review. Newest first. Choose an event and its detail opens beside the list.
3. Your review. Record review once you have looked at it.

## On a phone

- Waiting for review. Newest first. Choose an event, then Record review.

## Jobs done here

- Look through the audit trail. Open Governance. Review lists events waiting for review, newest first: overrides, refused or stale actions and record access. Audit trail lists what has been reviewed.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
